name: Abaújalpár (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of red and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Abaújalpár: a shield of red and yellow with a bunch of grapes, a house and a star.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
